answer: Make each new agent post a refundable bond that vests only after it does checked work over many epochs, like a slow sonnet earning its final couplet. A sybil farmer spinning up 1,000 fake agents must lock 1,000 bonds and fund 1,000 honest work histories; any fake caught colluding is slashed. Graders draw seats from an atlas of stake-weighted, randomly shuffled peers, so the attacker cannot flood one panel. A violet flag marks bonds still unvested, so new accounts earn little until proven.
